evidence_items.description: Authoritative authentication mode resolution logic in shared/auth/mode.py
precedence_rules: 1. ODP_AUTH_MODE: authoritative ('local' | 'oidc'); invalid value raises error; conflict with legacy flag raises error.
2. ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED: legacy boolean alias ('true' -> 'oidc', 'false' -> 'local'); invalid boolean string raises error.

3. DEPLOYMENT_OIDC_ISSUER_VARS: if any issuer variable (ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER, ODP_OIDC_ISSUER, ODP_GCP_OIDC_ISSUER, etc.) is configured with a non-placeholder value, resolves to 'oidc' for backwards compatibility with pre-contract deployments.
4. Unconfigured default: when no mode, no legacy flag, and no issuer variable are present, resolves to 'local'.
evidence_items.explicit_vs_unset_notes: Explicit ODP_AUTH_MODE=local or ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED=false forces 'local' even if legacy issuer variables are populated. Unset mode flags with a configured legacy issuer resolve to 'oidc'. Do not infer live D15 compliance from unset mode flags alone without live environment readback.

evidence_items.description: Web runtime resolver and OIDC enablement gate at apps/web/src/lib/auth/runtime.ts
precedence_rules: 1. ODP_AUTH_MODE: 'local' | 'oidc' (throws error if invalid or conflicting with legacy flag).
3. ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER: if configured and non-placeholder, resolves to 'oidc'.
evidence_items.gate_behavior: isOidcEnabled() returns false when resolveAuthMode() === 'local'. When mode === 'oidc', requires complete configuration (ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER, ODP_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, ODP_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET) or throws Error. Fail-closed on misconfiguration.

evidence_items.description: Login route conditionally suppresses OIDC UI and rejects OIDC provider requests when authMode is local
evidence_items.observation: Line 342 sets const showOidc = authMode === 'oidc'; Google login button is omitted from HTML when showOidc is false. Lines 303-308 return 404 / 503 error when provider=oidc request is received in local mode.

evidence_items.description: OIDC callback route fail-closed rejection at apps/web/src/app/auth/callback/route.ts
evidence_items.observation: GET handler resolves authMode (lines 49-62). If authMode === 'local', lines 64-73 immediately return HTTP 503 { error: { code: 'WEB_AUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED', summary: 'OIDC authentication provider is disabled.' } } with cache-control: no-store, without parsing credentials or contacting any identity provider. Authorization code exchange at line 104 is completely unreachable when authMode is local.

evidence_items.description: Deployment validation only requires OIDC vars when auth_mode=oidc
evidence_items.observation: Line 44 imports resolve_auth_mode; line 1426 resolves auth mode; line 1434 conditionally checks OIDC variables only when auth_mode == 'oidc'. Deployments in local mode pass validation without any OIDC secrets.

evidence_items.description: Terraform checks gate OIDC variable enforcement behind local.is_prod && local.oidc_enabled
evidence_items.observation: Conditions gate OIDC validation behind local.is_prod && local.oidc_enabled. Default password-first deployments do not require OIDC variables for terraform validate/plan.

evidence_items.description: Password login path operates without Google OAuth client secrets
evidence_items.observation: localAuth.ts verifies password credentials against the identity store using Argon2id. No Google OAuth client secret or external provider is referenced. Session creation uses ODP_WEB_SESSION_SECRET.

evidence_items.description: Session, CSRF, and throttle mechanisms maintain full integrity in password-first mode
evidence_items.observation: Sessions use __Host- prefix with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax. CSRF via Origin checks in route.ts. Login throttle persists in identity.login_attempts (loginThrottle.ts) before credential verification. Mechanisms operate completely independently of OIDC state.
